boot_wait_sb_checkin.description: systemAppCheckIn receives checkin from system app and triggers overlay dismiss

notes.purpose: T19: measure InterfaceNamer initialization and received system-app check-in. Filter interface events by identity.process == CommCenter. Check-in is observed in backboardd, not proof of Setup Assistant greeting.
notes.limits: Use --max-hits boot_wait_=32 and --max-hits userclient_start=0; require all hooks mapped and unsaturated. elapsed is host running time excluding debugger pauses, not the ARM virtual counter.
